profile_text.body:
Dropbox is a for-profit public company (ticker: DBX) founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. It offers cloud storage, file sharing, and collaboration tools, and describes itself as a secure, easy platform for organizing company content. Its product Dash is positioned as a way to save time by bringing all company content into one place, and the platform supports previews for 175 or more file types along with synced team folders.

On the AI side, Dropbox offers a product called Dropbox AI, categorized under Notes, Knowledge, and Meetings, which the company describes as providing document summaries, team data access, and sharing controls. The site notes integration with leading AI platforms to summarize content, create shared links, and save work back to Dropbox without switching tools, with built-in AI summaries described as coming soon. An MCP server, listed under the name ai.smithery/cindyloo-dropbox-mcp-server, enables users to search, browse, and read Dropbox files, find documents by name or content, and list folders.

Dropbox files with the SEC under CIK 0001467623, and its most recently reported annual revenue, from a 10-K covering the period ending December 31, 2025, was $2,521,000,000.
